criteriaDraft.reviewerTarget: Dr. Rushapol Sdawat, MD (Plastic & Reconstructive Surgery, Intrarat International Hospital)
criteriaDraft.clinicalGovernanceRule: Criteria remain editable in DRAFT status until Dr. Rushapol explicitly reviews and confirms Grade 0–3 & NA definitions and regional boundary landmarks.

0.label: Grade 0 — None / Youthful Taut Contour
0.clinicalCriteria: Continuous, uninterrupted mandibular border from gonion to menton; zero jowl overhang below the gonion-menton chord; taut malar/lower-cheek soft-tissue pad; no resting marionette sulcus or submental/platysmal laxity.

1.label: Grade 1 — Mild / Early Soft-Tissue Laxity
1.clinicalCriteria: Subtle early softening of the pre-jowl sulcus or nasolabial fold at rest; < 2 mm inferior deflection along the mid-mandibular border; mild lower-cheek descent without distinct skin fold overhang; cervicomental angle remains well-defined.

2.label: Grade 2 — Moderate Sagging & Crease Trough Deepening
2.clinicalCriteria: Visible jowl lobe interrupting the mandibular line below the gonion-menton chord; established nasolabial and marionette crease troughs at rest; moderate lower-cheek soft-tissue ptosis and submental fullness or early anterior platysmal banding.

3.label: Grade 3 — Severe Ptosis, Jowl Overhang & Platysmal Banding
3.clinicalCriteria: Prominent jowl lobule overhanging the inferior mandibular border with deep pre-jowl notch and marionette fold extending to the lower jaw edge; marked midface/lower-cheek descent; obtuse cervicomental angle with prominent submental laxity and vertical platysmal bands.

NA.label: Grade NA — Not Assessable (Occluded / Cut-Off / Lighting Artifact)
NA.clinicalCriteria: Region has < 90% in-frame visibility, is covered by a surgical mask/hand/garment/beard, is foreshortened on the far side of an oblique turn, or exhibits severe directional raking-light shadow artifact preventing reliable surface assessment.

regionalBoundaryRules.labelEn: Cheek & Lower Cheek Descent (Malar / Infraorbital to Oral Commissure)
regionalBoundaryRules.anatomicalLandmarks: Superior: infraorbital rim / zygomatic arch; Medial: pyriform aperture & nasolabial sulcus; Inferior: oral commissure plane; Lateral: preauricular / masseteric border.

regionalBoundaryRules.labelEn: Jawline Contour, Jowl Lobes & Marionette Sulcus
regionalBoundaryRules.anatomicalLandmarks: 21-point mandibular border from Right Gonion (172) through pre-jowl sulcus to Menton (152) and Left Gonion (397), including oral commissure-to-mandible marionette corridor.
Inferior to menton and submandibular border down to the hyoid / cervicomental junction.
Hyoid / cervicomental apex inferiorly to suprasternal notch / clavicular line, medial to sternocleidomastoid borders.
